mu_name_from: MuPlayer.PartsForClass in the old client: the body a class wears with no armour equipped is HelmClass{NN}, ArmorClass{NN}, PantClass{NN}, GloveClass{NN}, BootClass{NN}. The numbering runs one over MU's zero-based classes, so Class01 is the Dark Wizard, Class02 the Dark Knight and Class03 the Fairy Elf.
part_note: The head, 582 triangles. Bound to 389 on Bip01 Head, 12 on Bip01 Spine1. The Spine1 ring is taken onto the head by rebind, as on the other S17 heads.
sheet_from: Data/Player/HQSkinClass103.OZJ (256x256), from the Season 17 client (third_party/MuClient_S17_v1.19.74). All five of the Fairy Elf's parts name it.
rebind_from: As HelmClass02's: S17's head binds 389 vertices to Bip01 Head and a ring of 12 at the base of the neck to Bip01 Spine1, two joints down, and the head turns a long way from the chest in MU's poses (56 degrees in action 5), so a rigidly bound ring is wrung by all of it. Taken onto the head, as on every S17 head (the user, 2026-10-15).
cull_from: As HelmClass02, and for its reason rather than by default: MU's hair is flat single-sided fins, and a culled fin does not turn away from the camera, it vanishes. On a head with a ponytail there is more of it to wink out.
model_from: Season 17's remake of MU's Fairy Elf body, read out of Data/Player/HelmClass03.bmd in the S17 client: a version-14 file, which MuExtract opens through Webzen's ModulusCryptor (pipeline/MuExtract/MuAssets/Crypto). It replaced MuMain's HelmClass03 on 2026-10-15 at the user's call ("now fairy elf, then MG"). Its 51 bones are the first 51 of player.bmd's, by name and order, so it rides our rig and clips as MuMain's did.
unstack_why: Refuses the UV un-stacking, as MuMain's part did and as the Dark Wizard's do: MU shares one set of texels between a left and a right half, and the un-stacking once moved half a mirrored torso's faces off their twin and lost its painting (ArmorClass01, 2026-09).

uv_overrides.why: The face block, top left, with the ear and the neck under it.

uv_overrides_why: The face and the blond hair share shells; the islands are hair and the face is lifted out. Read off the sheet with the UV layout drawn over it (2026-10-15).
material_note: hair for the blond braid and fringe, skin for the face and neck.
